title: Candlekeep — AI support assistant
subtitle: AI Product & System Canvas · course reference case

verdict.label: GO → MVP experiment
verdict.summary: Problem and lever are clear; inference is pennies against $4.10 per message. Test routing with confidence first, on a 100-request golden dataset.

pattern: Composition: Structured output + Content generation + RAG (only when policy is needed)

1.text: 20,000 messages/month sorted and answered manually by 10 FTEs: ~$978K/yr, first response ~4 h. Constraint: assist-only first.

2.text: Primary: FRT ≤30 min. Secondary: escalation rate ≤ baseline. Timeframe: 12 weeks. Stop: if cost per request > $4.10, pause and rescope.

3.text: Customers: a fast personalized reply instead of a 4 h wait. Specialists: less manual sorting, more time for complex cases.

4.text: One-time: integration and workflow. Ongoing: serving + human review + monitoring. Unit: $/message ≤ half of $4.10. Payback 12–18 months.

5.text: 2–3 experienced specialists → whole support team → customer-visible scope. Gates: ≥70% of pilot use suggestions, quality thresholds hold.

6.text: Specialist workspace: on each new message — category, route and reply draft before the specialist answers.

7.text: Classify → route → retrieve policy if needed → draft. Off-the-shelf LLM → own classifier if required. Risks: misroute, confidently wrong draft.

8.text: Quality: misroute ≤10%, draft acceptance ≥60%. Performance: routing fast enough to improve FRT.

9.text: Offline: golden set of 100 + human review of edge cases. Live: shadow → assist. Expand by category. Roll back if below the bar.

10.text: Review / Approve / Edit / Escalate. AI-generated label, low-confidence flag, no auto-send. Only the customer data the task needs.

11.text: Where do return policies live and how often are they updated?

12.text: What runs the golden-set eval on every prompt/model change?

13.text: API (Token Factory) to start; who on the team owns the integration?

14.text: How do we ship new prompt versions: canary by category?

15.text: Alerts on rising misroute and latency; who is on call?

next_step: Offline experiment: routing only (category + department + confidence → JSON) on a golden dataset of 100 labelled requests.
